newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Road King gets nod for Jihe expressway.
newsitem.headline: Road King gets nod for Jihe expressway.

text.p: Road King Infrastructure Ltd, one of the biggest integrated toll-road investors and operators in China, said on Monday it has secured Shenzhen government approval for its Jihe expressway project.
The company has also acquired an additional 10 percent equity interest in the Luochong Highway in China's southern Guangdong province, it said in a statement.

In April this year, Road King and the Shenzhen Freeway Development Company signed a contract to jointly invest in and operate the eastern section of the Shenzhen Airport-Heao Expressway or Jihe Expressway.

Shenzhen authorities approved the project last month and registration of the joint venture company established for the project, the Shenzhen Airport-Heao Expressway (Eastern Section) Co Ltd, is now under way and expected to be completed this month, the statement said.
When completed, the Jihe Expressway will form a major east-west artery of Shenzhen.
The company also announced in the statement that it had increased its equity in the Luochong Highway in Guangdong province from 51 percent to 61 percent.
Road King's acquisition of additional equity interest in the Luochong Highway project has improved the overall joint venture terms for the company, it said.
Shares of Road King Infrastructure Ltd debuted at HK$8.50 last Thursday compared to their initial public offering price of HK$8.40.
